clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crusade's camp near Deathknell, a messenger carries Scarlet Crusade Documents through Tirisfal. The intercepted orders name field commanders and direct their forces, giving the Forsaken military leadership intelligence on Scarlet positions across the Glades.

Meven Korgal carried the documents from the Crusade's encampment southeast of Deathknell. By order of the Highlord, they direct the captains of the Crusade's Tirisfal Regional Command. Captain Perrine must further fortify the southwest tower and gather information on the undead in Brill. Captain Vachon must crush undead movement near the northern tower, while Captain Melrose watches the borders of the Plaguelands. The orders name Scarlet field officers, their posts, and their duties across Tirisfal Glades.

Executor Arren sees that Deathknell's local forces cannot use the full breadth of this intelligence. The captured documents become a newly awakened Forsaken's passport out of Deathknell. Carry them northeast, past Cold Hearth Manor, to Brill, and deliver them to Executor Zygand outside Brill Town Hall. With the orders in hand, Forsaken military leaders plan swift strikes against Scarlet commanders entrenched across the Glades.
